title: Origins: Bounded Mage
description: An origin made for Iron's Spells & Spellbooks. Trade Physical Abilities for Magical Prowess.
body:
# ⛓️ Bounded Mage Bound by a heavenly restriction, you are stripped of all physical strength and weapon use, but in return, your magical abilities are greatly amplified. ## Powerlist
Magical Prowess You're simply better. (When it comes to magic..)

+200 Max Mana
+100% Mana Regeneration
+40% Spell Power
+60% Spell Cooldown Reduction
+50% Spell Cast Time Reduction
+50% Spell Resistance
Physical Ineptitude God awful at everything but magic..

-3 Max Hearts
+15% Damage Received
-1000% Attack Damage
-70% Swim Speed
Item Incompetence Restricted weapon use. You are unable to use the right-click function of many weapons, shields, and types of bows.
Other Worldly Possession Upon arriving in this new land, you retained nothing but your spellbook and a single spell.

+Ironbound Tome [w/Divine Smite 1]
## Mod Information **Iron's Spells and Spellbooks is required.** _(The whole origin is based around it...)_ > The "Item Incompetence" power will work with limiting the usage of all items with these tags: #minecraft:bows, #minecraft:crossbows, #c:shields, #c:bows, #c:crossbows, #c:tridents, #forge:bows, #forge:tools/shields, #forge:tools/bows, #forge:tools/crossbow, #forge:tools/tridents.

**I've also added direct compatibility for these mods:**

Arch Bows
Bosses'Rise

Epic Knights: Shields Armor and Weapons

More Vanilla Shields

Too Many Bows
